'''Thull Vandron''' was a [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] [[Scout/Legends|explorer]] and hero of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] circa [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]]. Vandron led a fleet of [[Starship/Legends|starships]] against the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]]. He was also one of the architects of the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformations]], in opposition of central power. However, when the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] chose a different option, he retreated with a group of [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core-Worlders]] and headed to a region in the southern part of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] via secret trade routes. The region he chose was a cluster of [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] around a large [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]], which would later become the [[Senex-Juvex/Legends|Senex-Juvex]] region. The nebula would later be named in his honor: [[Thull's Shroud/Legends|Thull's Shroud]].<ref name="TEA" />

Here Vandron was able to apply his system of noble houses in both the western and eastern parts of the nebula. The eastern systems were divided between the Houses of [[House Vandron|Vandron]], [[House Garonnin|Garonnin]], [[House Elegin/Legends|Elegin]], [[House Picutorion|Anturi]], [[House Taneel|Taneel]], [[House Petro|Petro]], [[House Araba|Araba]], [[House Hax|Hax]], and [[House Viholn|Viholn]] and became the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex]]. The western systems were divided between the Houses of [[House Sreethyn|Sreethyr]], [[House Carbinol|Carbinol]], [[House Halliikeenovich|Halliikeenovich]], [[House Sisemon|Sisemon]], [[House Kassido|Kassido]], [[House Kellermin|Kellermin]], [[House Pilor|Pilor]], and [[House Mekuun|Mekuun]].<ref name="TEA" />
